description: This Java source file defines the KafkaExternalEventProducer class, which implements the ExternalEventProducer interface to send external events via Kafka. It uses Spring Kafka and Lombok annotations, retrieves configuration properties, and manages asynchronous message sending with timeout handling.

classes.name: KafkaExternalEventProducer
classes.description: A Spring component that produces external Kafka events based on provided message partitions, using configured Kafka templates and properties. It handles asynchronous sending and timeout logic with logging.

methods.name: sendEvents
methods.description: Sends a batch of byte-array messages partitioned by Long keys to Kafka topic, waiting for all to complete or timeout, with debug logging on message rate.
